Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii financiare, Bănci și Dezvoltare de software
Mid-Level SDET | Playwright, C#/.NET, CI/CD | Global Payments & Banking Company Building Its Own QA Function 
Salary: RON 210,000 - 270,000 gross per year (RON 17,500 - 22,500 gross per month)
Location: Bucharest, hybrid - 3 days in the office, 2 from home
Employment: via a local payroll partner until the company’s Romanian entity is set up
 Our long-standing client, an international payments and banking group, is building its own QA function in Bucharest from scratch, and I’m looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join it. You’ll be part of a team of around nine automation engineers, writing tests in Playwright. C#/.NET is their preference, though they’ll consider strong Python or Java engineers too.
 You’ll report to the Head of QA, with a dotted line to the Bucharest site lead, and work directly with developers in two-week sprints. Their estate spans five to ten internal and external systems, so you’ll test web apps, APIs, backend, Kafka event-driven services and some legacy Windows desktop apps, moving between projects on both sides of the business.
 Non-Negotiables 
Financial services: payments, SWIFT, banking
Playwright
C#/.NET (Python or Java considered)
SDET background, hands-on coding
CI/CD: GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
AI in your testing work, e.g. generating test cases
 What You’ll Work With 
NUnit, with some TypeScript
Kafka and Azure Service Bus
Azure Application Insights, KQL
Kubernetes (K8s), Docker
IaC: Terraform
Web apps and legacy Windows desktop apps
GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Foundry
TestRail, Jira
 Nice to Haves 
API testing: REST, contract, schema
End-to-end testing across connected systems
MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors
Load testing at high transaction volumes: k6, Artillery, LoadRunner
Service virtualisation, mocks, stubs
Azure (AWS also fine)
BDD: Gherkin, SpecFlow, Cucumber
Core banking platforms
 Why Join / Projects 
 We’ve worked with this client for several years and placed people across their tech teams. They’re an international business with a strong reputation in payments, and this is one of the more interesting builds we’re recruiting for in Bucharest.
You’re joining a new function rather than inheriting an old one. They’re replacing an outsourced testing supplier with their own people, and you’ll help shape the culture of a growing tech hub.
You’ll work across both sides of the business, payments and banking, so you see the whole estate rather than one product.
They’re building a template for agentic engineering across the software lifecycle, with QA as one of its pillars, so you’ll use AI tooling on the Microsoft stack day to day.
You’ll sit with developers in a small, collaborative team that moves quickly.
 Employee Benefits 
25 days’ holiday plus Romanian public holidays
Extra day off in your birthday month
Private medical cover
Annual salary review
Support for training and study
Long service awards
 Mid-Level SDET | Playwright, C#/.NET, CI/CD | Global Payments & Banking Company Building Its Own QA Function
